facts: Borders Greece, Turkey, Serbia, North Macedonia and Romania
The Danube forms the border with Romania, the Black Sea the east
worth_knowing: The Balkan Mountains run from west to east through the middle of the country. Musala, in the Rila range, is the highest point in both Bulgaria and the Balkans.
